code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    # The long diagonal of the repeated color is extended in its direction.
    if len(pts)>=3:
        dr=pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]
        if dr and abs(dr)==abs(dc):
            step=(1 if dr>0 else -1,1 if dc>0 else -1)

                r+=step[0]; c+=step[1]; out[r][c]=2
    return out
